name: Sous
tagline: Turns a fridge photo or a quick answer into dinner, and tracks the pantry
description: Answer one question or photograph the fridge and it settles on tonight's dinner from what you actually have. Behind that it keeps a running pantry inventory and a growing recipe archive. Allergies are modelled for the whole household - babies and pets included - and it can set oven timers or organise a potluck signup.
author: Sabathius
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
